name: a1111-lms-adapter
description: TypeScript adapter that wraps AUTOMATIC1111's Stable Diffusion Web UI HTTP API while routing prompts through LM Studio (or any OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint) for prompt enhancement first.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist-esm/package.json', JSON.stringify({type:'module'}, null, 2))"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run build
